Game Overview

At its heart, K-Pop Card Collection is a girls' game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of K-Pop Card Collection follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is K-Pop Card Collection?

K-Pop Card Collection is a free girls' game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is K-Pop Card Collection free to play?

Yes, K-Pop Card Collection is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
